status: Digital evidence reconciled; physical fit, printing and load testing are unmeasured

observed_features.finding: 22 distinct native-derived meshes and 22 actual slices reconcile to the final manifest: six main pieces, eleven alternative fit samples, two exact brace/rim trials, three fixture files with five required printed pieces.
observed_features.scope: No physical print, cleanup, fit or load result is claimed.

observed_features.finding: Automatic Tree Hybrid support is used for A/B, both brace trials, four downward bearing-mouth trials and three sleeve/nut trials. Final slices contain support/interface paths inside A bearing pocket and B four nut pockets. Clean matching fit samples before assessing hardware fit.
observed_features.scope: An earlier organic-tree diagnostic emitted an influence-area warning. Final Hybrid slices were selected after review. Diagnostic directories are superseded and some precede the final B pad correction.

observed_features.finding: No sealed support cavity identified. A bearing mouth and B nut pockets open at the joint face; B hub cup/side slots remain open. Distal roofs can be reached through the 141 mm across-flats end and adjacent lattice.
observed_features.scope: Geometrically accessible for removal; physical cleanup trial required. Fused interface on precision contacts and branches looping around members remain practical risks.

observed_features.finding: A0 retains shallow distal braces, nodes and end-rim closure. A90 retains the complete shallow brace and nodes. Both preserve scale, q print-up direction, 45-degree yaw and nominal 0.2 mm layer phase relative to full A.
observed_features.scope: Support height, thermal mass and layer time differ. Local geometry/removal screens do not establish whole-housing adhesion or structural capacity.

observed_features.finding: Actual 3MF matrices preserve exported orientation; automatic Arrange rotation is disabled independently of Auto Orient. All non-Custom model/support/brim centre lines pass installed X1C bed/exclusion checks and a separate 0.5 mm centreline-clearance screen. A/B minimum bed-edge centreline clearances are 6.73/8.728 mm.
observed_features.scope: Custom startup/purge/calibration paths, extrusion width and physical machine condition are excluded. Review the plate after changes.

observed_features.finding: Quantities multiply separate one-part plates. Filament includes support/brim. The model-printing-time field includes supports and is only printing-phase time. Six V4.1 main pieces total 648.387089 g and 95800.997742 s including preparation.
observed_features.scope: Slicer estimates, not measurements. Fit sizes are alternatives. No stiffness-normalized or support-normalized comparison to earlier revisions is implied.

observed_features.finding: Only A/B/F and three sleeve/nut trials changed: 0.3 mm equal-distance relief on eight free spoke-opening bed contours in each housing, B four nut mouths, F four sleeve bed mouths and its shaft-clearance bed mouth. C/D/E, all bolt bores, bearing trial rings and exact brace/rim trials remain unchanged. Actual slices retain0.15 mm elephant-foot compensation. Mesh cross-sections at0.1/0.3/0.5 mm remain closed single connected material regions in all six changed files.
observed_features.scope: The housing edges meet inclined walls, so equal-distance chamfer is not uniformly45 degrees to the bed. Actual first-three-layer outer walls were reviewed separately. Fit, adhesion and support detachment remain unmeasured. Estimated A/B mass changed chiefly through automatic support/path regeneration; removed CAD volume is only about0.17 g PLA across the two housings, so the estimate difference must not be described as bevel-material savings.

limits: Totals multiply one-part separate-plate estimates by assembly quantities; they are not a combined-plate schedule.
Material and printing-phase estimates include any generated supports; no unsupported model-only mass breakdown is inferred.
Mesh closure and successful slicing do not establish absence of unsupported toolpaths.
Extrusion move length includes anchors and is not an unsupported span.
Fit, adhesion, bridge sag, stiffness, strength and fatigue require physical tests.

public_export.note: Public derivative: local workstation prefixes have been replaced with workspace-relative provenance paths. Historical measurements and geometry are unchanged; original evidence is retained in the authoring workspace.
